decision_summary: Admit the exact-C512 FP8 QKV M128 cp.async/register-feed implementation only as a positive test-only first cell with its pinned layer-0 real-checkpoint gate passed. Production dispatch, the model runner, Decode, and MTP remain unchanged.

Three independent fixed-clock six-round B-C-C-B screens improve the production M128 QKV baseline from a three-process mean of 4.800425 ms to 3.435777 ms, or 1.397187593956x. All 18 round speedups are at least 1.396620x and clear the frozen 1.15x per-round and 1.20x aggregate gates.

The candidate retains the same logical FP8 weight payload and the same 13,107,200 executed HMMA instructions, but Nsight Compute does not show unchanged global traffic: measured global-load sector requests rise from 629.15 MB to 681.57 MB, an exact logical-size delta of 52,428,800 bytes attributable to the LDGSTS path. L2 traffic and DRAM read utilization rise as well.

The matched profiler evidence is nevertheless consistent with useful latency hiding: long-scoreboard stalls fall from 1.70 to 0.09 per issue-active interval while duration falls from 4.80 to 3.47 ms. This is profiler evidence for this isolated synthetic cell, not a production or full-model claim.

The read-only pinned layer-0 linear_attn.in_proj_qkv.weight tensor passes direct plus two-Graph-replay bitwise correctness and three independent fixed-clock timing processes at 1.301166x to 1.301422x; all 18 rounds are at least 1.300979x.

The remaining promotion gates are a full P513 model comparison, production memory ownership, and production dispatch validation. Any retained design must avoid long-term simultaneous residency of canonical and fragment-native sidecar weights; promotion requires a single-resident representation or another bounded ownership plan that also preserves Decode correctness.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Orin, one deterministic checkpoint-like synthetic exact-C512 QKV fixture, one read-only pinned layer-0 checkpoint tensor, three independent eager timing processes per payload, and matched synthetic-cell single-kernel Nsight Compute captures

experiment.role: compare the public production FP8 whole-chunk M128 QKV kernel with one test-only traffic-changing M128 implementation

baseline.name: public production FP8 M128xN128 whole-chunk QKV kernel

candidate.name: test-only FP8 QKV M128 triple-stage raw-A/B cp.async register-feed kernel
candidate.mapping: retain production M128xN128 CTA ownership and eight ordered M16 accumulator panels per warp
pipeline: Stage raw M128xK64 BF16 A and fragment-native N128xK64 FP8 B through three dynamic-shared slots using cp.async.
Decode each K16 B plane from raw shared bytes directly into the frozen SM87 matrix_b fragment registers.
Remove the production decoded-B shared stores, decoded-B ldmatrix reads, and the second K64 synchronization boundary while retaining exact HMMA ordering.

sass.interpretation: The candidate preserves tensor-core work while changing raw A/B delivery, FP8 decode placement, shared-memory traffic, and synchronization. Equal HMMA work does not imply equal memory traffic.

matched_nsight_compute.protocol: one matched profile-baseline launch and one profile-candidate launch from the same measured binary

counter_comparison.display_units: MB and ratios as displayed by Nsight Compute
counter_comparison.interpretation: The equal-byte sidecar does not enlarge the logical FP8 tensor, but the candidate issues 52,428,800 additional bytes of measured global-load sector requests. LTS traffic and DRAM read utilization also increase. The speedup therefore comes despite higher measured traffic and coincides most strongly with the long-scoreboard collapse, fewer decoded-B shared round trips, and the shorter synchronization path.

promotion_boundary.current_admission: test-only positive first cell with pinned layer-0 real-checkpoint correctness and performance gates passed
required_next_gates: Run full-model P513 mirrored baseline/candidate timing with exact generated-token and Decode non-regression gates.
Demonstrate a bounded memory ownership design that does not keep canonical and sidecar QKV tensors resident together long term and preserves all Prefill and Decode consumers.
Only after those gates, evaluate production dispatch and broader QKV/Z/O reuse.
promotion_boundary.retention: retain the BUILD_TESTING launcher and screen as reproducible positive evidence while production dispatch stays frozen
